title: Setup Run and Head Bound
statement: Let $M_V$, $M_I$, and $M_P$ be Boolean Turing machines, let $x$ be a Boolean word, and let $Q,t,s$ be natural numbers. Suppose $M_P$ halts on $x$ after $t$ steps with output consisting of $Q$ true symbols, and uses at most $s$ work-tape cells by that time. Then the host machine built from these three machines reaches, at some time $T$, a configuration in its loop phase with the counter decrement phase active, input-head position $1$, and its first word tape storing $Q$ false symbols and its last tape storing $Q$ true symbols. At every time $u\le T$, the absolute position of every work-tape head is at most $s+Q+1$.
